claim: NIXL provides point-to-point transfer abstractions across memory and storage through plugins
The inference conductor owns allocations and metadata exchange while NIXL performs transfers
The agent validates descriptors, tracks registrations and remote metadata, selects a compatible backend, and tracks transfer status
The UCX backend implements registration, posting, and completion behind the generic agent interface
The C++ example registers DRAM buffers, exchanges metadata, posts a WRITE, polls completion and notification, and releases resources
Mooncake exposes transfer and shared-store infrastructure for inference workloads
The vLLM Mooncake Store worker imports the store package and integrates cache loading and saving
The store Client exposes Query, Get, Put, and batch operations
The master implements replica lookup and PutStart/PutEnd object lifecycle operations
Transfer Engine exposes memory registration, transfer batches, submission, and completion status
A store read queries replica metadata, selects a complete replica, transfers bytes, checks errors and validates lease lifetime
Client::Get selects a complete replica, transfers into slices, checks checksum, and rejects an expired lease
Client integration tests exercise the Store client through its service boundaries
The transfer benchmark demonstrates direct Transfer Engine usage independently of serving cache semantics
